L106: 【38†Inkigayo】 Chart winners (2025)
L107: ---
L108: The Inkigayo Chart is a 【39†music program】 【40†record chart】 on 【41†Seoul Broadcasting System】 (SBS) that gives an award to the best-performing 【42†single】 of the week in South Korea. The show aired every Sunday at 3:20 p.m. KST and was broadcast from the SBS Open Hall in 【43†Deungchon-dong】, 【44†Gangseo-gu, Seoul】.^{【45†[1]】}^{【46†[2]】} Every week, the show awards the best-performing single on the chart in the country during its live broadcast.
L109: The show had been hosted by 【47†Han Yu-jin】, 【48†Leeseo】, and 【49†Moon Seong-hyun】 since April 2024.^{【50†[3]】} In September 2025, Han Yu-jin and Moon Seong-hyun stepped down from their positions. 【51†Shinyu】 joined Leeseo as a new host on October 19,^{【52†[4]】} followed by 【53†EJ】 on November 9.
